description: This file defines a RouteSubscriber class for Drupal's Field UI module, which alters routing definitions for entity types related to field management.

classes.name: RouteSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to routing events to modify routes related to the Field UI in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects the EntityTypeManager service.

methods.name: alterRoutes
methods.description: Alters the route collection to add routes for entity field management based on entity type definitions.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically altering routes.
